model.scope_statement: Canonical registry of externally claimed tool capabilities used for workflow/diagram decisions.

tools.label: Graphviz dot renderer
tools.notes: Local portable Graphviz is preferred; PATH fallback allowed.

tools.label: MkDocs CLI (python -m mkdocs)
tools.notes: Used to confirm local docs server/build tool availability via Python module entrypoint.

tools.label: Mermaid CLI (mmdc)
tools.notes: Optional renderer; currently not required in this repo. If installed locally, prefer the pinned version via npm devDependency.

claims.statement: Graphviz dot can render DOT input to SVG output (dot -Tsvg).
claims.scope: Workflow control plane generated SVG views.
claims.notes: Local tool availability is separately observed in toolchain_capabilities.json.

claims.statement: Graphviz supports grouped process views (clusters/subgraphs), styling (colors/fill), and labels, enabling colored grouped workflow diagrams and legend patterns.
claims.scope: Planned grouped views, color coding, labels, and legend for workflow control plane diagrams.
claims.notes: Exact visual conventions remain repo-specific and must be implemented in generator.

claims.statement: Mermaid CLI is available and suitable as a maintained SVG renderer in this repository workflow.
claims.scope: Optional future renderer path for generated workflow diagram views.
claims.notes: Repo policy decision: optional, pinned target is @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.12.0 when adopted. Current workflow uses Graphviz for SVG rendering.

notes: Purpose: prevent unsupported categorical statements about external tool capabilities in workflow decisions.
Policy: capability claims used for decisions must be verified and source-backed; otherwise status must remain unknown.
Mermaid CLI policy: optional path only; if installed locally, prefer pinned @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.12.0 and treat version mismatch as warning until promoted to active renderer.
